_comment: A SEPARATE beat service, for anyone running more than one worker replica.
The default deployment does NOT use this file. railway.worker.json runs
`worker --beat`, so one service is both the scheduler and the consumer.
That is deliberate: a beat service is a fourth always-on container to pay
for, and its absence is silent -- scheduled posts simply stay PENDING with
no error anywhere, which is exactly what happened.
`worker --beat` is only safe on a SINGLE replica. Two of them means two
schedulers. dispatch_due_posts is protected by FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED so
posts would still publish once, but the other periodic tasks have no such
guard. Scale the worker past one replica and you must split beat back out
using this file, and drop --beat from the worker's start command.
